question: How can one become dear to the yoginīs through supreme accomplishment?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
One who possesses this great accomplishment gains favor.
The yoginīs hold such an accomplished one dear.
inference: Therefore, attaining the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One who has the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
